name: Ohio
summary: A swallowtail pennant with red and white stripes and a blue triangle at the hoist bearing 17 white stars around a red disc in a white circle. It is the only non-rectangular US state flag.
origin: The architect John Eisenmann designed the flag for the Ohio building at the Pan-American Exposition in Buffalo in 1901. It was adopted on 9 May 1902. Precise construction rules were set in 2005.

symbols.name: Seventeen stars
symbols.description: Thirteen around the disc and four more grouped near the point.
symbols.meaning: Ohio as the 17th state; the 13 for the original states.

symbols.name: Red disc in white circle
symbols.description: A white O around a red disc.
symbols.meaning: The O of Ohio and the buckeye nut, from the 'Buckeye State'.

facts: It is the only US state flag that is not rectangular.
Ohio law describes how to fold it: 17 folds, one for each star.
Nepal's flag is the only non-rectangular national flag.
clues: A swallowtail pennant with stripes, a blue triangle and a white O around a red disc.
The only non-rectangular US state flag.
Its circle stands for a letter and a nut.
